ORDER SUMMARY (customer success copy)
Customer: Kestrel Estates, ordered through a local installer acting as reseller
Order placed: August 2026
Currency: pounds sterling

What was ordered
- 1 dock with aircraft, and the FlytBase platform.
- Installation by the installer. Not by FlytBase.

Price and term
- 14,000 a year for the platform subscription, paid in full through the installer.
- Term: 14 September 2026 to 13 September 2027.
- No automatic renewal.

Not included
- Operator training or certification. The reseller order form leaves these to the reseller.
- Onboarding by FlytBase customer success.
- Any site survey beyond the installed position.

Support
- Standard support: support desk in business hours.

history.detail: A local installer ordered 1 dock and a one-year platform subscription for Kestrel Estates. The installer's order notes describe the purpose as mapping the whole estate.
Dock installed by the installer. See the install note in the account's files.
14,000 a year, paid in full through the installer.
Dana Whitfield emails to ask when the dock starts flying. Automatic acknowledgement only.
No onboarding call was ever held. The account passes to you.

on_file_as_open_at_handover.basis: Paid for and not flying. Nothing on file says why.

data.note: What the estate needs, and what any next step is worth, is in the account brief and in what you find out.
The dock registered to this account. `commissioned` is empty: no commissioning flight is on record.

records.text:
From: Dana Whitfield, Kestrel Estates
To: FlytBase (general address)
Date: 19 October 2026
Subject: Our dock

Hello,

We had a dock installed on the gatehouse roof five weeks ago. It has been paid for. It has not
flown. The firm that installed it has stopped answering.

Who do I speak to, and when does it start?

Dana Whitfield
Estate manager

---
From: FlytBase (automatic reply)
Date: 19 October 2026

Thank you for your message. A member of the team will be in touch.

[No further reply on file.]
